subject.title: fix(gateway): recover when suppressed channel secrets are unavailable

question: Should a successful `secrets.reload` automatically restart accounts that were running when crash-loop safe mode was entered, or must safe mode continue requiring an explicit `channels.start` request?
rationale: The central bug only requires preventing suppressed channel SecretRefs from blocking control-plane startup, while this branch additionally changes the documented emergency-recovery contract and channel-delivery behavior.

options.title: Keep startup-only recovery
options.body: Preserve the existing explicit-start safe-mode contract and narrow this PR to the source/assignment startup projection fix.

options.title: Approve account-aware reload
options.body: Adopt automatic restart of previously running accounts, but require owner approval, updated contract documentation, and exact-head supervised stop/restart/rollback proof.

options.title: Select the competing candidate
options.body: Pause this PR while maintainers choose whether https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/106405 is the safer canonical startup-only landing path.

recommendation.title: Keep startup-only recovery
recommendation.body: Preserve the existing explicit-start safe-mode contract and narrow this PR to the source/assignment startup projection fix.

likelyOwner.reason: The safe-mode reload and manual-override semantics originate in their persisted crash-loop breaker implementation.
